lane: 1A - fixed-graph reservoir control via imitation of a hand-written teacher
sensor_dim_note: world.py declares SENSOR_DIM=8 but obs_vector() returns 7 values (4 light + hx, hy, wall). The specified (8, neurons) projection is drawn but only its first 7 rows are used.

mode_notes.blink3: light sensors zeroed except every 3rd step
mode_notes.blink8: light sensors zeroed except every 8th step

metric_note: mean_steps_to_success follows world.summarize: it averages SUCCESSFUL episodes only, so read it together with success_rate/timeouts. Success is saturated for the teacher, which is why steps is the discriminating metric.

open.note: delta = reservoir steps - other steps, on the episodes where both succeeded; negative = reservoir faster; 4000-sample paired bootstrap
